title: Bangalore Property Price Per Sq Ft: How Much Does Property Cost in 2026?
seoTitle: Bangalore Property Price Per Sq Ft in 2026
description: Explore Bangalore property prices per sq ft in 2026 with Naverah Assets. Compare area-wise rates, key price factors, and tips to assess whether a property quote is fair.
body:
Ask three people what a flat costs in Bangalore and you’ll get three answers, all of them right. A compact apartment on the far side of the Outer Ring Road and a three-bedroom in Indiranagar sit in the same city and nowhere near the same market.

The Bangalore property price per sq ft you’ll be quoted in 2026 depends on the corridor, the developer, the floor, and whether the number covers carpet area or super built-up area. Naverah Assets helps property buyers understand these differences when comparing projects across Bangalore. Understanding what sits inside that figure matters more than memorising it, because two projects quoting identical rates can leave you paying very different amounts for the same amount of usable space. With guidance from Naverah Assets, buyers can make more informed property decisions based on their budget, location preferences, and long-term goals.

What the Bangalore Property Price Per Sq Ft Actually Includes

Almost every quote in Bangalore is on super built-up area, which bundles your flat with a share of lobbies, corridors, staircases and amenity space. The loading ranges from around 15 percent in older buildings to well past 30 percent in newer amenity-heavy towers. Ask for the carpet area in writing and divide the total cost by that instead. The comparison changes fast.

The base rate is also rarely the whole story. Expect floor rise charges of a modest amount per square foot per floor, preferential location charges for corner or park-facing units, and separate line items for covered parking, club membership, corpus fund, water and power connections. Two projects quoting the same headline number can land 8 to 12 percent apart once these are added.

Indicative Bangalore Property Rates Per Sq Ft by Corridor

The table below gives broad 2026 ranges for apartments. Treat them as indicative, because they move with the specific project, developer and micro-location rather than the corridor as a whole.

Corridor Indicative range per sq ft Character
Prime central (Indiranagar, Koramangala, Lavelle Road area) Very high, well into five figures Scarce supply, mostly resale and boutique projects
Established south (Jayanagar, JP Nagar, Bannerghatta Road) High Mature infrastructure, steady demand
East (Whitefield, Sarjapur Road, Bellandur) Upper mid-market Deepest tenant base, heavy traffic
North (Hebbal, Yelahanka, Thanisandra) Mid to upper mid-market Airport corridor, wide roads
Devanahalli and airport belt Mid-market, lower entry Long-horizon appreciation play
Outer south and west fringes Most affordable Value buying, thinner social infrastructure

Prime addresses can sit at three or four times the rate of outer corridors, and villa or plotted developments follow their own logic entirely. Bangalore property rates per sq ft also differ street by street inside a single corridor. Always compare the flat rates Bangalore projects quote against recent registered transactions in that pocket rather than against listing portals.

What Moves Price Per Square Foot Bangalore Wide

A handful of factors do most of the work.

• Operational metro connectivity. A station that’s running lifts nearby rates in a way an announced line does not.

• Employment density. Corridors near tech parks, GCC campuses and the aerospace belt hold value because tenants and end users compete for the same stock.

• Road infrastructure. Widening, flyovers and the peripheral road network shift rates in the pockets they actually serve.

• Land scarcity. Central areas have almost no new supply, which is why rates there barely correct.

• Developer reputation. A builder with a clean delivery record commands a premium buyers willingly pay, and that premium usually survives resale.

Guidance value, published by the state and revised periodically, sets the floor for stamp duty rather than the market rate. Market price per square foot Bangalore buyers actually pay generally sits above it, and the gap tells you how hot a pocket has become.

Bangalore Property Rate Trends Worth Watching


Metro-led corrections upward

Pockets along extending metro lines tend to see rates firm up once services actually begin, not when the line is announced. If you’re buying ahead of an opening, you’re taking a timeline risk in exchange for a lower entry.

The north Bangalore story

Devanahalli, Bagalur and the surrounding belt have seen sustained interest thanks to the airport, business parks and improved road access. Entry rates remain lower than east Bangalore, and Bangalore property rate trends there have been driven more by land absorption than by rental demand, which is worth knowing before you buy for income.

Premium supply outpacing mid-market

Several developers have shifted toward larger, higher-specification units, which lifts the average apartment price per sq ft in a locality without every project necessarily becoming more expensive. Read averages carefully.

Why Two Flats in One Locality Differ So Much

Within a single project, the apartment price per sq ft can vary by 10 percent or more between the lowest and highest floors. Add facing, tower position, park views, and whether the unit overlooks the driveway or the generator room. That spread explains why flat rates Bangalore listings advertise rarely match what a specific unit costs.

Across projects in the same locality, the drivers are loading percentage, amenity scale, construction specification, the developer’s brand, and how much of the project is already sold. Launch-phase rates in a new tower usually sit below the same tower’s rates at handover, which is exactly why investors watch for early inventory.

From Quoted Rate to What You Actually Pay



Take the quoted number and add the following before you compare anything:

1. Floor rise and preferential location charges.

2. Covered parking, club and corpus contributions.

3. GST, if the property is under construction.

4. Stamp duty of roughly 5 percent and registration of about 1 percent in Karnataka, plus cess and surcharge.

5. Legal verification, khata transfer and loan processing fees.

6. Interiors, which almost always exceed the first estimate.

A quoted rate on paper commonly translates into an all-in cost 12 to 18 percent higher. Budget for that from the start rather than discovering it at registration.

How to Check Whether Your Bangalore Property Price Per Sq Ft Is Fair

Do these four things before you negotiate. Look up the guidance value for the survey number on the state’s registration portal, so you know the statutory floor. Ask a local advisor or two for recent registered sale rates in that specific pocket, not the wider area. Compare at least three projects on carpet-area cost rather than super built-up rate. Then run a rental sanity check: if the achievable rent gives you a gross yield well under 2.5 percent, the asking rate is likely ahead of the local market.

This is general information rather than investment advice, and rates change with supply, interest rates and infrastructure timelines, so verify current numbers with a qualified professional before you commit.

Frequently Asked Questions


1. What is a realistic Bangalore property price per sq ft in 2026?

It depends entirely on where you’re looking. Outer corridors remain the most affordable, east and north Bangalore sit in the mid to upper mid-market band, and prime central pockets run several times higher. Get corridor-specific numbers, because a city-wide average will mislead you in either direction.

2. Are quoted rates based on carpet or super built-up area?

Almost always super built-up, which includes your share of common areas. Loading typically ranges from 15 percent in older buildings to over 30 percent in new amenity-led projects. Ask for carpet area in writing, then recalculate the effective rate. That single step reveals which project is genuinely cheaper.

3. Why is guidance value lower than the market rate?

Guidance value is the government’s minimum for calculating stamp duty, revised periodically rather than continuously. Market rates respond to demand, supply and infrastructure much faster. A wide gap usually signals a pocket where demand has run ahead of the official assessment, which is common in fast-developing corridors.

4. Do prices in Bangalore ever fall?

Corrections happen, usually as flat or slow-growth periods rather than sharp drops, and they hit oversupplied outer pockets hardest. Established locations with limited land tend to hold value better. Anyone promising guaranteed annual appreciation in any corridor is selling optimism rather than analysis.

Conclusion

Chasing a single number is the wrong approach. The Bangalore property price per sq ft that matters to you is the one for your shortlisted project, recalculated on carpet area, with floor rise, parking, GST and registration folded in, then checked against what similar flats nearby have actually registered for recently. Compare three projects to spot the outlier and avoid relying on citywide averages or outdated price estimates.
